The pain becomes worse in the evening, but I have not had any vomiting or difficulty breathing. I took Panadol five hundred milligrams twice yesterday, which helped for a few hours. I am not taking any other medication, and I do not have any known drug allergies.

Good morning, doctor. I have had a sore throat, fever, and pain when swallowing for about three days. I have not had any difficulty breathing, but I feel very tired. Have you taken any medication so far, and do you have any known drug allergies? I took paracetamol five hundred milligrams twice yesterday. It helped with the fever. I do not have any known drug allergies. Your symptoms are consistent with a throat infection. I am prescribing amoxicillin five hundred milligrams three times a day for five days. You may take paracetamol five hundred milligrams when needed for fever or pain, but do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Okay. When should I come back? Drink plenty of fluids and rest. If you develop difficulty breathing, a severe rash, or your symptoms become significantly worse, seek medical attention earlier. Otherwise, arrange a follow-up in five days if the symptoms have not improved.

I have been feeling dizzy since Monday, especially when I stand up quickly. I sometimes feel nauseous, but I have not vomited. Have you had chest pain, shortness of breath, blurred vision, fainting, or weakness in your arms or legs? No, I have not had any of those symptoms. I have been drinking less water than usual because I have been very busy. Are you currently taking any regular medication? No, I am not taking any regular medication. Your symptoms may be related to dehydration, although we should continue to monitor them. Increase your fluid intake and stand up slowly rather than suddenly. I am not prescribing any new medication today. What should I do if the dizziness continues? Come back for review in three days if it has not improved. If you faint, develop chest pain, severe shortness of breath, or new weakness, seek urgent medical attention.

My blood pressure was one hundred and fifty over ninety-five yesterday evening. This morning it was one hundred and forty-two over ninety. I have also had mild headaches during the last week. Have you experienced chest pain, palpitations, fainting, or changes in your vision? No. I have not had any of those symptoms. How long have you had high blood pressure, and what medication are you taking? I was diagnosed about four years ago. I currently take amlodipine five milligrams every morning. Continue taking amlodipine five milligrams once every morning. Do not increase the dose yourself. Please record your blood pressure once in the morning and once in the evening for the next seven days. When should I see you again? Bring those readings to a follow-up appointment in one week. If you develop severe chest pain, fainting, significant shortness of breath, or a very severe headache, seek urgent medical attention rather than waiting for the appointment.

I developed a dry cough about six days ago. For the first two days, I had a temperature of thirty-eight degrees Celsius and felt very tired. Do you still have a fever? Are you short of breath? The fever has settled. I do not have difficulty breathing while resting, but I sometimes feel slightly short of breath after climbing stairs. Do you smoke, or do you have a history of asthma? No, I do not smoke, and I have never been diagnosed with asthma. At the moment, continue resting and drinking plenty of fluids. You may take paracetamol five hundred milligrams if the fever or body aches return. I am not prescribing antibiotics today. How long should I wait before coming back? If the cough is still present after another five days, arrange a follow-up appointment. Come back earlier if the fever returns, your breathing becomes difficult, or your symptoms significantly worsen.

For about two weeks, I have been having burning pain in the upper part of my stomach, particularly after eating spicy food or drinking coffee. Sometimes I feel acid coming up into my throat when I lie down at night. Have you vomited blood, noticed black stools, lost weight unexpectedly, or had difficulty swallowing? No. I have not noticed blood in my vomit or stool, I have not lost weight, and I am eating normally. Have you tried any medication for these symptoms? I tried omeprazole twenty milligrams once daily for three days. It helped a little. I would like you to take omeprazole twenty milligrams once every morning before breakfast for fourteen days. Avoid eating immediately before going to bed, and try to reduce spicy food and coffee during this period. When should I return? Arrange a follow-up in two weeks so we can review whether the treatment helped. Come back earlier if you develop severe abdominal pain, difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, or unexplained weight loss.
